items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I knew Irving very well. I always had a very nice relationship with him

ctx.x: I don't know. Do you know what he did?

I knew Irving very well. I always had a very nice relationship with him, but I just don't think that -- I know a story, but I don't know the truth of it, and I wouldn't want to say it on account of that, but I do know that Duke was raised to the top category of ASCAP and Irving's name was on all of the songs and he didn't raise him. So who knows? And you and I know very well, that he may have said, 'Well, we'll call that the 'Dirty River Blues',' and maybe they brought it in and it was the 'Clean River Blues.'…
No. I'm really curious though, whether Duke Ellington learned something valuable from Irving Mills.
